Here is a product description and key features summary for an Eccentric Reducer tailored for the Pipes & Tubes category:

Product Description
The Eccentric Reducer Pipe Fitting is engineered to join two pipes of different diameters where one side of the fitting remains flat or parallel to the pipe run. Unlike concentric reducers, which taper centered on a single axis, an eccentric reducer features an offset centerline. This design allows for a smooth, flat-bottom or flat-top alignment across pipe transitions.

Ideal for horizontal piping applications, eccentric reducers are primarily installed flat-side-down in liquid suction lines to prevent vapor bubbles from collecting and causing pump cavitation. They are also installed flat-side-top in steam and gas transport systems to prevent condensation pooling. Manufactured from industrial-grade Stainless Steel, Carbon Steel, and Alloy Steel, these fittings ensure exceptional resistance to pressure, stress, and corrosive process media.
